tok 1.0 "Budget planning"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane dept "Department"
    start begin "Budget period approaching"
    task outline "Outline the objectives"
    task draft "Draft the plan"
    task adjust "Adjust the plan"
    task document "Document the adjustment"
    task approveadj "Approve the adjustment"
    task implement "Begin implementing the plan"
  lane mgmt "Management"
    task align "Review the plan in the strategic alignment meeting"
    xor aligned "Plan aligned?"
    task allocate "Allocate the budget"
    task distribute "Distribute the budget"
  lane fin "Finance department"
    task review "Review the budget feasibility"
    xor feasible "Budget feasible?"
    xor merge ""
    end done "Budget distributed"

flow begin -> outline -> draft -> merge
flow merge -> align -> aligned
flow aligned -> review "yes"
flow aligned -> adjust "no"
flow review -> feasible
flow feasible -> allocate "yes"
flow feasible -> adjust "no"
flow adjust -> document -> approveadj -> merge
flow allocate -> distribute -> implement -> done
